Answer: D
Reason: The lateral view (Figure 1b) localizes the opacity indicated by the arrow to the posterior aspect of the lower lung zone, consistent with a left lower lobe consolidation. This peripheral/posterior distribution with ground-glass opacities is a characteristic radiological pattern for COVID-19 pneumonia, whereas the other options describe findings typical of bacterial abscesses, malignancy, or heart failure.
